main_body: pair of wooden crates with metal corner brackets
top_band: light tan/brown horizontal planks on rows 0-8 (large crate) and rows 8-14 (small crate)
evidence: Large crate has a 9-row horizontal planked top band (rows 0-8) ending in a light front edge at row 7-8, followed by a dark eave/recess shadow at row 9 and an inset diagonal-braced front face on rows 9-19. Small crate similarly has a 7-row top (rows 8-14) over a recessed front face (rows 15-23).

style.evidence: Crates use 5 brown shading steps and 2 steel bracket tones with dark brown material outlines rather than pure black. Plank striping, recessed panel shadows, and diagonal bracing prevent flat fills, though per-plank grain is slightly simpler than the reference stall.
